Info

Provides container encapsulating outbound binary payload unpacker service contracts.

class scaralang.infrastructure.protocol.binary.parser.unpacker.provides.UnpackerProvides(motion: IBinaryMotionPayloadUnpacker, actuator: IBinaryActuatorPayloadUnpacker, system: IBinarySystemPayloadUnpacker, response: IBinaryResponsePayloadUnpacker)[source]¶

Bases: object

Immutable container providing outbound binary payload unpacker interfaces.

It defines:

attributes:
motion - Bound IBinaryMotionPayloadUnpacker service contract.
actuator - Bound IBinaryActuatorPayloadUnpacker service contract.
system - Bound IBinarySystemPayloadUnpacker service contract.
response - Bound IBinaryResponsePayloadUnpacker service contract.
actuator: IBinaryActuatorPayloadUnpacker¶
motion: IBinaryMotionPayloadUnpacker¶
response: IBinaryResponsePayloadUnpacker¶
system: IBinarySystemPayloadUnpacker¶
